verdicts.reason: The two layouts are almost the same; the only difference is that B's 'Saturday 21 June' is slightly larger, which makes it compete more with the headline without fixing anything. Both share the same flaws: 1) The 'RSVP Free' CTA is shrunk to the size of the FREE ENTRY, ALL AGES and TASTINGS pills and placed in their grid, so it reads as a fourth tag. 2) Its 'Reserve a spot' URL line is stranded far right under the product. 3) 'Sessions' crowds the bottom-left edge. 4) The legal line is unreadably tiny, and a red placeholder box sits clipped at the bottom edge.
